name: com.osir/domain-registrar
title: OSIR Domain Registrar
description: Register and manage domains, DNS, VPS, email, and self-hosted AI agents with 113 tools. By OSIR.

tools.name: addPrefixToDomain
tools.description: addPrefixToDomain: Generate domain suggestions by adding prefixes to a base name.

vocabulary.description: Prefix vocabulary: "@prefixes" or a custom comma-separated list.

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs without leading dots, e.g. "com,net".

tools.name: addSshKey
tools.description: addSshKey: Store an SSH public key on your account so it can be injected into VPS installs. Idempotent: storing a key you already have returns the existing one instead of creating a duplicate, so it is safe to call before every order. Returns the key id to pass to orderVps or buildVpsInstance. Requires authentication.

name.description: A label for the key, e.g. 'laptop'.

publicKey.description: The full single-line OpenSSH public key, e.g. 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA... user@host'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: addSuffixToDomain
tools.description: addSuffixToDomain: Generate domain suggestions by adding suffixes to a base name.

vocabulary.description: Suffix vocabulary: "@suffixes" or a custom comma-separated list.

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs without leading dots, e.g. "com,net".

tools.name: buildVpsInstance
tools.description: buildVpsInstance: Stage an operating system install (or reinstall) on a VPS instance. DESTRUCTIVE: ERASES ALL DATA on the server, including any deployed application, and cannot be undone. The install is asynchronous; afterwards poll getVpsInstanceDetails until buildState is COMPLETE. If an Osir app was deployed onto this instance, a rebuild erases it; re-attach it afterwards with osirAppDeployToVps. Never rebuild a box just to install an app runtime by hand. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

hostname.description: Hostname for the rebuilt server; defaults to the instance's current hostname.

operatingSystemId.description: Integer OS template id from listVpsOsTemplates, resolved with this same instanceId.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

sshKeyIds.description: Integer SSH key ids from listMySshKeys, injected during install; without one you may not be able to log in.

tools.name: bulkDomainSuggestions
tools.description: bulkDomainSuggestions: Generate domain suggestions for 1-10 keywords across 1-6 TLDs (hard cap), grouped by originating keyword. Typical flow: call listCategorizedTlds first to pick 3-6 TLDs, then this tool. Per-suggestion availability may be "available", "taken", or "unknown"; confirm "unknown" or premium-TLD names with checkDomainAvailability before recommending.

tlds.description: 1-6 TLDs without leading dots (use "tech", not ".tech"), chosen from listCategorizedTlds.

tools.name: cancelTransfer
tools.description: cancelTransfer: Stage cancellation of a pending domain transfer. DESTRUCTIVE and irreversible once executed. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name whose pending transfer to cancel, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: changeVpsPaymentTerm
tools.description: changeVpsPaymentTerm: Stage a change of the payment term (billing cycle) for a VPS instance. Affects what you are billed. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: checkDeviceLoginStatus
tools.description: checkDeviceLoginStatus: Poll for device login completion. Call this after loginWithDevice() once you have opened the verification URL and signed in. Required: deviceCode (the device_code returned by loginWithDevice). On success returns a sessionKey; pass it as the sessionKey argument on every subsequent authenticated tool call.

deviceCode.description: The device_code value returned by loginWithDevice.

tools.name: checkDomainAvailability
tools.description: checkDomainAvailability: Check if a domain name is available for registration, with price. No authentication required; anonymous callers get list pricing, authenticated callers get their account pricing. Required: domain (e.g., 'example.com')

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to check, like "example.com", without scheme.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: checkHostAvailability
tools.description: checkHostAvailability: Check if a host/glue record name is available for creation. Requires authentication. Returns whether the hostname is free; call before createHost.

hostname.description: Fully qualified host name to check, e.g. 'ns1.example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: checkKeywordAvailability
tools.description: checkKeywordAvailability: Check keyword availability across all supported TLDs and registries with detailed per-domain results. Use checkKeywordAvailabilitySummary instead when you only need counts; it is faster.

keyword.description: Keyword to check, without a TLD, e.g. "example".

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs without leading dots, e.g. "com,net".

tools.name: checkKeywordAvailabilitySummary
tools.description: checkKeywordAvailabilitySummary: Check keyword availability across TLDs and registries. Summary statistics only (no per-domain results), faster than checkKeywordAvailability.

keyword.description: Keyword to check, without a TLD, e.g. "example".

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs without leading dots, e.g. "com,net".

tools.name: countMyVpsInstances
tools.description: countMyVpsInstances: Get the total count of VPS instances owned by the authenticated user. Requires authentication.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: createAccount
tools.description: createAccount: Create a new OSIR customer account; step 1 of onboarding, no authentication required. The contact must be the PRINCIPAL's real ICANN registrant contact (the human or business the account is for), never the AI agent itself. Sends a verification email; complete via verifyAccount with the emailed code. While PENDING_VERIFICATION the account can search, quote and fund; billable actions need ACTIVE. Calling again for a PENDING account re-sends the verification email.

acceptedTerms.description: Must be true; requires the principal's actual consent to the OSIR terms of service.

agentName.description: Name of the AI agent acting for the principal, recorded for the audit trail.

agentVendor.description: Vendor of the AI agent acting for the principal, recorded for the audit trail.

contact.description: The principal's real ICANN registrant contact (firstName, lastName, email, phone, street1, city, country), never the AI agent itself.

email.description: Account login email; valid mailbox that receives the verification code.

password.description: Optional account password; if omitted the account is agent-managed until a password is set.

principalReference.description: Principal's own reference identifying who the agent acted for, recorded for the audit trail.

termsVersion.description: Version of the OSIR terms the principal accepted, e.g. '2026-09'.

tools.name: createContact
tools.description: createContact: Create a new contact for use with domain registrations. Requires authentication. Returns the created contact including its id for assignment to domains (registerDomain registrantId). For .al domains (AKEP): registryAttributes is required, postalCode is required, state is the region not the country, no ';' in street, prefer plain ASCII. For a company use the director or contact person as first/last name, the company as organization, entityType 'Person Juridik Privat', its NIPT/VAT, and the director's ID or passport.

country.description: Country as a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US'.

organization.description: Organization or company name, if any.

registryAttributes.description: Registry-specific fields. REQUIRED for .al (AKEP): entityType, doctype, docnr, and nipt for every entityType except 'Person Natyror'. Omit for other TLDs.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

state.description: State, province, or region, if applicable.

street2.description: Second street address line, if needed.

tools.name: createDnsRecord
tools.description: createDnsRecord: Create a new DNS record for a domain. Requires authentication. For newly registered domains the zone is initialized automatically if missing. Returns the created record including its id for later updates or deletion.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name the record belongs to, e.g. 'example.com'.

name.description: Record name relative to the zone, e.g. 'www', 'mail', or '@' for the apex.

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA.

content.description: Record value, e.g. an IPv4 dotted-quad or IPv6 address for A/AAAA, a hostname for CNAME/MX/NS, or text for TXT.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; defaults to 3600 when omitted.

priority.description: Priority for MX/SRV records only; defaults to 0 when omitted.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: createHost
tools.description: createHost: Create a new host/glue record, e.g. for custom nameservers like 'ns1.example.com'. Requires authentication. Check the name first with checkHostAvailability. Returns the created host record.

hostname.description: Fully qualified host name to create, e.g. 'ns1.example.com'.

ipAddresses.description: IP addresses for the host, IPv4 dotted-quad or IPv6, e.g. ['192.0.2.1', '198.51.100.1'].

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: createMailbox
tools.description: createMailbox: Stage creation of a paid mailbox on a mail-enabled domain. BILLABLE: deducts from account balance; get a quote with getMailboxQuote and confirm the price with the user first. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve. The result of the confirmed action contains the generated password EXACTLY ONCE; it can never be retrieved again, so show it to the user immediately (they can change it later with setMailboxPassword). Also share the client settings from the result (IMAP/SMTP/webmail).

domain.description: An ACTIVE mail-enabled domain from listMailDomains.

localPart.description: The part of the address before the @; the full mailbox address becomes 'localPart@domain', e.g. 'user@example.com'.

packageId.description: Mailbox plan id from listMailPlans; there is no default.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: createPaymentSession
tools.description: createPaymentSession: Stage a Stripe checkout session to add funds to the account balance. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve. The executed result includes checkoutUrl (hand it to the human to pay) and expiresAt; then poll getPaymentTransactions until the balance credit appears.

amount.description: Amount to add to the balance, in the account currency as a decimal (e.g. 25.00).

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: enableMailDomain
tools.description: enableMailDomain: Enable email hosting on a domain you own. Free; mailboxes are what cost money. If the call fails with a DNS conflict (an existing SPF or MX record), ask the user for explicit consent, then re-call with spfMergeConfirmed=true and/or takeoverConfirmed=true. Requires authentication.

domain.description: The domain to enable email hosting on, e.g. 'example.com'.

dnsMode.description: 'PDNS_AUTO' (default) publishes all mail DNS records automatically; the domain must use our nameservers. 'EXTERNAL_MANUAL' returns the DNS records for you to publish at your DNS provider, and the domain stays PENDING_DNS until verifyMailDns succeeds.

spfMergeConfirmed.description: Set true, only with the user's explicit consent, to replace a foreign SPF record.

takeoverConfirmed.description: Set true, only with the user's explicit consent, to repoint a foreign MX record; this moves their live email.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: executeConfirmedAction
tools.description: executeConfirmedAction: Execute a previously staged destructive or financial action after user approval. The action expires after 5 minutes and can only be executed once.

actionId.description: The action UUID from the staging tool's response.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: fundBalanceWithSharedPaymentToken
tools.description: fundBalanceWithSharedPaymentToken: Stage adding funds to the balance by charging a Stripe Shared Payment Token the customer granted to OSIR. Use when a purchase (registerDomain, renewDomain, transferDomain, orderVps) failed for insufficient funds: that error tells you the networkId to mint against and both amounts. Mint the token for the GROSS and pass the NET as creditCents. Tokens are single-use. Requires authentication. Returns an actionId; tell the user what the card will be charged, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve. If this fails in any way you cannot fix by minting a fresh token, fall back to createPaymentSession and give the user the checkout URL.

sharedPaymentToken.description: The Stripe Shared Payment Token, 'spt_...'. Minted for the GROSS amount against the networkId from the insufficient-funds error. Single-use.

creditCents.description: NET amount to land in the balance, in minor units (cents). Use fundNetCents from the insufficient-funds error. The card is charged this plus the processing fee.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code, default USD. Must match the balance currency.

maxChargeCents.description: The usage_limits max_amount the token was minted with, i.e. fundGrossCents. Supplying it lets OSIR reject an impossible charge without calling Stripe.

description.description: What the funds are for, e.g. 'Funding registration of example.com'. Lands on the customer's transaction record.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

Returns an actionId; present the summary and call executeConfirmedAction only if the user approves. Requires authentication.

tools.name: osirAgentDeploy
tools.description: osirAgentDeploy: Install a ready-made AI agent - Hermes (Hermes Agent by Nous Research, a self-hosted personal AI agent with a web dashboard) - on the user's OWN VPS, behind HTTPS with a password-protected dashboard. Use this for 'run/install Hermes on my server' INSTEAD of osirAppDeploy, a hand-written Dockerfile, SSH or an install script: the platform installs the vetted agent itself. Needs a VPS with at least 4 GB RAM. TWO WAYS IN, like osirAppDeployToVps: (1) the user already owns a VPS: pass instanceId (from listMyVpsInstances) - spends nothing, no confirmation; (2) no server yet: pass packageId (from listVpsPackages, 4 GB+ RAM) - stages a VPS order (COSTS MONEY): returns an actionId; present the price/summary and call executeConfirmedAction only if the user approves. The result carries the username and the PASSWORD: show the password to the user once, in that reply - it is never shown again (osirAgentResetPassword makes a new one). Then poll osirAgentStatus until installed - it gives the dashboard URL (without a domain, Osir assigns the address; never build it) - and connect a model provider with osirAgentConfigure. Calling this again resumes an install and never buys a second VPS. If the platform says the agent is not available yet, tell the user plainly. Requires authentication.

agent.description: The agent to install. Currently only 'hermes'.

instanceId.description: Id of a VPS the user ALREADY owns, from listMyVpsInstances. Nothing is ordered or charged. Never invent one.

packageId.description: VPS package id from listVpsPackages (at least 4 GB RAM). Only when a server has to be ordered; omit it when passing instanceId.

domain.description: A domain the user owns to serve the dashboard on, e.g. 'agent.example.com'. Bound automatically if its DNS is hosted at Osir, otherwise the result says which A record to add. Omit it to get an Osir address automatically; never pass an osir.app name.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: osirAppDeploy
tools.description: osirAppDeploy: Deploy an app to Osir (free tier) and get a live HTTPS URL; the app runs isolated in a microVM. Send the project's source as 'files' (each {path, content}) - you never zip, upload or make an HTTP request yourself. Returns immediately with status BUILDING: poll osirAppStatus until READY (typically 1-2 min, up to ~7 for a first build) before telling the user the URL is live; if it ends BUILD_FAILED, fix the source and redeploy - never deploy around a failed build by hand. Deploying an existing app name redeploys it (new version) and applies any secrets set via osirAppSetSecret. A plain static website (HTML/CSS/JS with no framework or build step) is also supported: it is auto-detected and served directly; pass language 'node' for it. If the project has its own Dockerfile at the root, the platform builds exactly that: pass language 'node' for it; the container must listen on port 8080. Shared-tier apps get 256 MB / 0.5 CPU, so a big image-based app belongs on the user's own VPS (osirAppDeployToVps). For a ready-made AI agent (Hermes), use osirAgentDeploy - never this tool and never a hand-written Dockerfile. To put the app on the user's OWN VPS, server or production box instead, deploy it here first and then call osirAppDeployToVps - never SSH into the box or write an install script. Once an app is on the user's own VPS, redeploying HERE under the same name is how you update it: the platform re-ships it to the box and keeps its domain. Requires authentication.

files.description: The project's source files: [{path, content, encoding?}]. path is relative and forward-slashed (e.g. 'src/index.js'); encoding is 'utf8' (default) or 'base64' for binaries such as images. Include every file the app needs - omitted files are not in the new version. Up to 500 files / 6 MiB. Use this OR uploadTicket.

language.description: Runtime language: 'node', 'python', 'php-laravel', or 'go'; use 'node' for a plain static site or a project with its own Dockerfile.

name.description: App name: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, e.g. 'habit-tracker'.

region.description: Region: 'us' or 'al' ('al' is Albania/Tirana); defaults to the platform's home region.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

uploadTicket.description: Only for the shell path: upload ticket from osirAppCreateUpload, after PUTting the zipped source to its putUrl. Leave out when sending files.

tools.name: osirAppDeployToVps
tools.description: osirAppDeployToVps: Deploy a live Osir app onto the user's own VPS / server / production box, moving it off the shared free tier. Use this INSTEAD of SSH, a provisioning or install script, nginx/systemd/TLS configuration, or any manual server setup - the platform ships the app to the box itself over its own deploy key, so the assistant needs no shell access and no outbound SSH. This is the ONLY supported way to put an app on a user's own server or a custom domain. TWO WAYS IN. (1) The user already owns a VPS: pass instanceId (from listMyVpsInstances) and NO packageId - this ATTACHES the app to that server, SPENDS NOTHING and needs no confirmation. (2) No server yet: pass packageId (from listVpsPackages) and the call stages a VPS order (COSTS MONEY): returns an actionId; present the price/summary to the user and call executeConfirmedAction only if they approve. Before staging any order this tool checks whether the user ALREADY has a box for this app (its C2 binding, then their own VPS list) and attaches that instead - a retry after a failed move never buys a second server. After the move starts the platform ships the app onto the box server-side, which takes about two minutes; watch it with osirAppStatus ('ownedMove'). Calling this tool again while a move is still running just reports its progress, and calling it after one FAILED retries the ship - unless osirAppStatus says the VPS refused the Osir deploy key or its web ports are taken: then retry only after the user has made the changes that message lists. If the result status is BUILDING or BUILD_FAILED, follow its nextStep. After the move the app is served ONLY from the user's server: its earlier osir.app address stops working. Give the user the URL from osirAppStatus, and never tell them the old link still works. Requires authentication.

appName.description: The deployed app's name, as shown by osirAppList.

packageId.description: VPS package id from listVpsPackages. Required ONLY when a server has to be ordered; omit it when passing instanceId.

instanceId.description: Id of a VPS the user ALREADY owns, from listMyVpsInstances. Given this, the app is attached to that server and nothing is ordered or charged. Never invent one.

domain.description: Custom domain to serve the app on; DNS is bound automatically if the domain is hosted on osir.app nameservers, otherwise the result returns the IP and manual DNS instructions.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: osirAppGetSource
tools.description: osirAppGetSource: Get a deployed Osir app's current source, to make edits without the user re-attaching the project. With inline=true it returns the files themselves: patch them and call osirAppDeploy with ALL the files under the SAME name; the platform rebuilds and, for owned-tier apps, auto-ships the new version to the user's box. If the result says truncated=true the files are only PART of the app - do NOT redeploy from them. Without inline it returns only a short-lived signed zip URL (getUrl), useful only to a client with a shell. Requires authentication.

appName.description: The deployed app's name, as shown by osirAppList.

inline.description: true (recommended): return the files themselves (up to 300 files / 2 MiB). false/omitted: only a signed zip URL.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: osirAppSetSecret
tools.description: osirAppSetSecret: Set an environment secret for an Osir app (e.g. DATABASE_URL, API_KEY). The value is stored encrypted and injected as an env var on the next osirAppDeploy of the app; it is NEVER returned or logged. Requires authentication.

tools.name: osirAppStatus
tools.description: osirAppStatus: Get an Osir app's current status, live URL, and health ('is my app working?'). If the status is BUILD_FAILED, 'recentErrors' explains why so you can fix the source and redeploy. 'qa' is an independent black-box check of the LIVE app after deploy: qa.status PASSED means it loaded and worked; FAILED means it deployed but didn't actually work, and qa.findings lists the problems so you can fix and redeploy. 'ownedMove' tracks a move onto the user's own VPS, which leaves tier and status unchanged while it runs: state MOVING (in progress, stage says where, ~2 minutes in total), MOVED (done - tier reads 'owned'), FAILED or REFUSED (follow this result's message: usually call osirAppDeployToVps again to retry, which never orders a second server; but when the VPS refused the Osir deploy key or its web ports are taken, the user must fix the VPS first, and the message says how). For an app on the user's own VPS (tier 'owned'), health is always UNKNOWN: the platform does not probe the user's server. Use qa to tell whether it works; do not redeploy because of UNKNOWN. Requires authentication.

appId.description: App id from osirAppList or a deploy result.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

Call it before osirSitePublish for a new site, then publish the finished page with osirSitePublish. No authentication needed.

audience.description: Who visits the site and why.

pageJob.description: The page's single job: get_contact, sell_product, book_appointment, collect_signups, inform_portfolio, or other.

Ask the user rather than inventing values; skipped extras are fine.

tools.name: osirSitePublish
tools.description: osirSitePublish: Publish a single-page website to a live HTTPS URL on Osir (free tier). ANY complete HTML document works: the user's own site, a page designed in this chat, or one from the osirSiteDesignBrief flow. Calling again with the same name redeploys the new version. For MULTI-FILE sites (separate CSS/JS/images) use osirAppDeploy with all the site's files instead. Then poll osirAppStatus until READY. If the app was moved to the user's own VPS, redeploying under the same name updates it there and keeps its domain. Requires authentication.

name.description: Site name: lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, e.g. 'bar-mediterran'.

html.description: The complete <html> document to publish (max 1 MiB).

designContract.description: Set true ONLY for pages generated via the osirSiteDesignBrief flow; additionally enforces its output contract (exactly one <h1>, self-contained, no external scripts/CSS except Google Fonts, no iframes). Never set it for a user's own site.

tools.name: registerDomain
tools.description: registerDomain: Stage registration of a new domain name. Deducts from account balance. The DNS zone is initialised automatically after registration (asynchronously; if createDnsRecord right after registration reports a missing zone, retry after a few seconds). Pass initializeDnsZone:false to opt out. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve. Owner: pass registrantId (a saved contact from createContact/listContacts) or an inline registrantInfo. For .al domains: first createContact with registryAttributes (see its schema), then pass the returned id as registrantId; ask the user for nameservers rather than guessing. A .al domain ends in pendingCreate until the registry (AKEP) approves it by hand - that is success, not a failure.

autoRenew.description: Enable automatic renewal; defaults to true.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to register, like "example.com", without scheme.

initializeDnsZone.description: Initialise the DNS zone after registration; defaults to true.

privacyProtection.description: Enable WHOIS privacy protection; defaults to true.

registrantId.description: id of a saved contact (createContact/listContacts) to use as registrant, and as admin/tech/billing contact. REQUIRED for .al: without it the account's default contact becomes the registrant.

registrantInfo.description: Inline registrant contact of the domain owner: firstName, lastName, email, phone (+CC.number), and address (street, city, postalCode, country as 2-letter ISO code). Omit when passing registrantId. Not usable for .al.

registryAttributes.description: Optional per-order override of the registrant's registry fields (same shape as createContact.registryAttributes). Only for .al.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: setMailboxPassword
tools.description: setMailboxPassword: Set a new password on a mailbox. Never log or store the password. Requires authentication.

password.description: The new mailbox password; never log or store it.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: spinDomainWords
tools.description: spinDomainWords: Generate domain suggestions by spinning/replacing words with similar alternatives.

position.description: 0-based index of the word to replace.

tlds.description: Comma-separated TLDs without leading dots, e.g. "com,net".

tools.name: suggestAlternatives
tools.description: suggestAlternatives: Suggest alternative domain names if the requested one is unavailable. Legacy; prefer generateDomainSuggestions.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to find alternatives for, like "example.com", without scheme.

limit.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return; default 10.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: transferDomain
tools.description: transferDomain: Stage transfer of a domain from another registrar to OSIR. Deducts from account balance. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve. Owner: pass registrantId (a saved contact from createContact/listContacts) or an inline registrantInfo.

authCode.description: EPP authorization code obtained from the current registrar.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to transfer, like "example.com", without scheme.

registrantId.description: id of a saved contact (createContact/listContacts) to use as registrant, and as admin/tech/billing contact. Wins over registrantInfo.

registrantInfo.description: Inline registrant contact of the domain owner: firstName, lastName, email, phone (+CC.number), and address (street1, city, postalCode, country as 2-letter ISO code). Omit when passing registrantId.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: unlockDomain
tools.description: unlockDomain: Stage removal of registrar lock from a domain to allow transfers. DESTRUCTIVE: reduces domain security. Returns an actionId: present the summary to the user, then call executeConfirmedAction with the actionId if they approve.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to unlock, like "example.com", without scheme.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: updateContact
tools.description: updateContact: Update an existing contact's information. Requires authentication. Only the fields you provide are changed; omitted fields keep their current values. Get the contactId from listContacts. Returns the updated contact. To make a contact usable as a .al registrant, send registryAttributes (see createContact).

contactId.description: Identifier of the contact to update, as returned by listContacts.

country.description: New country as a 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US'.

phone.description: New phone number in '+CC.number' format, e.g. '+1.5551234567'.

registryAttributes.description: Registry-specific fields (.al / AKEP: entityType, doctype, docnr, nipt). REPLACES the whole stored set, so send every field, not just the changed one. Omit to keep the current ones.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: updateDnsRecord
tools.description: updateDnsRecord: Update an existing DNS record. Requires authentication. Only the fields you provide are changed; omitted fields keep their current values. Get the recordId from listDnsRecords. Returns the updated record.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name the record belongs to, e.g. 'example.com'.

recordId.description: Identifier of the record to update, as returned by listDnsRecords.

name.description: New record name relative to the zone, e.g. 'www' or '@' for the apex.

type.description: New record type: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SRV, CAA.

content.description: New record value, e.g. an IPv4 dotted-quad or IPv6 address, hostname, or text.

ttl.description: New time to live in seconds.

priority.description: New priority for MX/SRV records only.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: updateDomainAutoRenew
tools.description: updateDomainAutoRenew: Enable or disable auto-renewal for a domain.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name, like "example.com", without scheme.

enabled.description: true to enable automatic renewal, false to disable it.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: updateDomainPrivacy
tools.description: updateDomainPrivacy: Enable or disable WHOIS privacy protection for a domain.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name, like "example.com", without scheme.

enabled.description: true to enable WHOIS privacy protection, false to disable it.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: updateNameservers
tools.description: updateNameservers: Update nameservers for a domain. Replaces the current nameserver set with the given list.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name, like "example.com", without scheme.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

tools.name: validateDomainName
tools.description: validateDomainName: Validate if a domain name format is correct. No authentication required.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to validate, like "example.com", without scheme.

tools.name: verifyAccount
tools.description: verifyAccount: Verify a newly created OSIR account with the code from the verification email; step 2 of onboarding, no authentication required. The code is the same token as the email link, so the principal can relay it to their agent. On success the account becomes ACTIVE and billable actions are unlocked. If the code expired, call createAccount again with the same email to get a fresh one.

code.description: Verification code from the email sent by createAccount.

tools.name: verifyMailDns
tools.description: verifyMailDns: Check that a mail domain's DNS records resolve; activates the domain for email when all records are found. Returns any still-missing records. Requires authentication.

domain.description: The mail-enabled domain to verify, e.g. 'example.com'.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.
